responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain robust DBT data pipelines and data models to support buyer experience, experimentation and ecommerce tracking
Build resilient and auto-recoverable data pipelines for data transformations subject to strict SLAs, performance expectations and data quality standards
Optimize data pipelines and debug analytical use cases and data quality issues.
Develop data models following best practices and industry standards
Functionally understand ecommerce business processes especially in the areas of customer transactions, ecommerce website experimentation and AB testing
Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business OKRs into technical solutions
Document and maintain the data catalog to enable data democratization and governance
Define semantic views with clear business context and metadata to enable AI-ready, self-service data consumption
Ensure data security, compliance, and cost efficiency across environments.
Mentor and guide other data platform associates with solutioning, code reviews and best practices adoption.

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Build resilient and auto-recoverable data pipelines for data transformations subject to strict SLAs, performance expectations and data quality standards
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Reliability language runs through the responsibilities — resilient, auto-recoverable, "strict SLAs", plus a whole governance and security block — with no speed or shipping vocabulary.
evidence.domain_risk: Ensure data security, compliance, and cost efficiency across environments.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Compliance and security are named responsibilities, not sector inference, and the pipelines carry ecommerce customer transactions for a marketplace with "200M+ combined annual visitors".
evidence.data_team_maturity: Mentor and guide other data platform associates with solutioning, code reviews and best practices adoption.
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: A data platform group already exists for the hire to mentor, and the catalogue and governance practices are maintained rather than created.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, develop, and maintain robust DBT data pipelines and data models to support buyer experience, experimentation and ecommerce tracking
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The bullets name the tool, the domain and the consumers — ecommerce tracking, AB testing, semantic views — so a reader can picture the actual work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Functionally understand ecommerce business processes especially in the areas of customer transactions, ecommerce website experimentation and AB testing
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Experimentation and the buyer-facing ecommerce funnel are the named consumers of the models, with governance and self-serve work secondary.
evidence.autonomy_level: By taking full ownership of sophisticated transformation designs and data modeling, you will fundamentally shape G2’s data environment
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role summary hands over ownership of the data environment and the bullets follow with define, design and mentor verbs.
evidence.ai_role: Define semantic views with clear business context and metadata to enable AI-ready, self-service data consumption
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The hire builds the semantic layer that AI consumption runs on, matching the summary's "AI-ready data architectures"; nothing asks them to use AI tools themselves.
evidence.testing_framing: Optimize data pipelines and debug analytical use cases and data quality issues.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality sits in the responsibilities as work the hire owns, alongside pipelines held to "data quality standards", rather than as a tool in a skills list.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure data security, compliance, and cost efficiency across environments.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance, security and compliance get their own responsibility block on top of strict SLAs, so the risk of untrusted or exposed data is framed as the hire's standing concern.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Design, develop, and maintain robust DBT data pipelines and data models to support buyer experience, experimentation and ecommerce tracking
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Build verbs and maintenance verbs are evenly split — design and build new pipelines, but also "Optimize data pipelines and debug analytical use cases and data quality issues".
evidence.loss_aversion: Risk framing is explicit and recurring: "Ensure data security, compliance, and cost efficiency across environments." alongside pipelines "subject to strict SLAs, performance expectations and data quality standards".
ats_keywords: semantic layers or AI-ready data products
data governance, security, and compliance standards
